item.title: Monaghan boxer on Katie Taylor announcement
item.description: A Monaghan boxer has praised Katie Taylor's talent and impact on women's boxing. She was reacting to the announcement that Taylor will be retiring this year, after one last fight. Christina McMahon is a former world boxing champion and one of Ireland's first professional boxers. item.title: Tributes paid to Cavan man and former Northern Sound presenter
item.description: Tributes are being paid to Cavan man and former Shannonside Northern Sound presenter. Sean Byers passed away yesterday, peacefully at the Sheelin Nursing Home, Mountnugent. The Kilnaleck man is remembered as a presenter of Shade of Green on the station for over 20 years. item.title: Locals stand in solidarity with SNA's in Monaghan
item.description: A Co Monaghan mother has highlighted the urgent need to increase the number of SNA's in schools as opposed to decreasing it. Olivia Larkin organised a protest in Monaghan Town yesterday evening to highlight the importance of SNA's to families and schools across the region. The coalition did a U-turn last week on plans to cut SNA allocations across the country. item.title: Cavan protest: 'Time Ag Minister listened to us'
item.description: A huge crowd of local farmers attended a meeting to discuss the ongoing IFA protest in Co. Cavan last night. Farmers attended the meeting in solidarity with the "Bord Bia 5" who have been protesting inside Bord Bia buildings for almost a month. Farming organisations, along with opposition TDs and several County Councils, are calling for Larry Murrin to step down from his role as Bord Bia chair. item.title: Senator calls on for change to bus driver age limit
item.description: A local Senator has called for the government to remove the retirement age for school bus drivers, if they are medically fit. Speaking in the Seanad this week, Senator Robbie Gallagher raised the issue of the retirement age of 70 years old for Bus Éireann drivers. Bus Éireann's policy maintains that drivers over 70 shouldn't drive larger vehicles, such as coaches, for medical reasons. item.description: A Co Cavan senator has once again highlighted capacity issues on the 109X bus service. Senator Pauline Tully says the issue is heightened at evening times on return routes to Co Cavan. The Sinn Fein representative met with officials from Bus Éireann in relation to the concerns that have been relayed to her. item.title: Dairy Beef Welfare payments commence in Cavan
item.description: Payments worth over €201,000 have commenced to farmers in Cavan. This is a part of the Dairy Beef Welfare Scheme. Payment of €20 per eligible calf (up to a maximum of 50 calves per applicant herd) will be made to eligible participants. Advertisement The scheme will reopen in April 2026 for new applicants, but farmers who applied in 2024 or 2025 do not need to reapply as their participation in the scheme will automatically continue. item.title: Figures for IDA supported jobs revealed locally
item.description: The latest figures have been revealed for jobs in IDA-supported companies, with new details for counties Cavan and Monaghan. That's according to figures given in response to a parliamentary question asked by Brian Stanley. Figures published show 1,629 people were employed in IDA-backed firms in Cavan in 2024. item.title: PFAI vote against Ireland playing Isreal
item.description: The Professional footballers of Ireland have voted against Ireland facing Israel in the nation’s league. The Professional football association of Ireland (PFAI) members voted 63% against Ireland fulfilling the fixture. Whereas, two-thirds of members saying they will not attend the game if goes ahead. 66% of members voted against attending the game, 79% of those members say that was due to moral reasons.
